scope: Independent V23 homepage-based authoring source, geometry, runtime and sampled visual review. Final encoded MP4 playback/decode remains a separate delivery gate.

checks.homepage_css: Original cinematic-motion.css copied byte-for-byte and loaded by stage.html; original fixed 1600x1000 canvas, 289/1180 split, 15px base UI and quiet compact surfaces are used.
checks.capability_coverage: 23 distinct original capability IDs preserved; contiguous 60-second sequence retained, with six cinematic feature inserts.
checks.visual_coverage: Inspected 69 state samples across four contact sheets, corrected graph-edit/plugin-invest/glaux samples, and final automation frame-45.562.png. Reviewed input, selection, result and app text continuity; no remaining blocking clipping of the primary feature demonstration.
checks.runtime: 161 independent semantic/geometry samples, 23 same-feature shell/prompt DOM identity checks, 46 transitions at 30fps neighbours and at +/-0.00001 second. Browser errors: 0. Source unchanged during these checks.

camera_continuity.finding: No discontinuous camera jump at inspected result thresholds or within-group feature boundaries; fast intentional pans remain.

checks.conversation_flow: Prior question context is retained within each group; send button, pressed state and pending state provide a causal input-to-response flow. DOM reconciliation retains matching shell/input nodes instead of replacing the complete UI each frame.
checks.source_content: Native candle plot, graph node/edge labels, node flow, recorded code, actual backtest/trade rows and mini plot retained. Approval, order and memory-change examples remain proposals or mock review states, not claimed live executions.
checks.text_policy: App labels/questions/buttons/axes/node names/code/table text remain visible. ATHENA and established main film captions remain. Only external Enter cue, small ending subtitle and in-film music credit stay hidden.
checks.scope_integrity: V22 and original app/source recordings were not edited by this reviewer. Reviewer wrote verification artifacts and updated verify-output.py to bind V23 review hashes to the final render.

resolved_findings: Initial generic camera aimed at blank composer or clipped primary result: replaced by feature-specific anchors and operation focus.
User question was hidden until result: now appears during submitted/pending state.
Question context reset between related capabilities: prior question bubbles now retained.
End-of-group camera used an incorrect double scale blend: corrected; settings and graph change proposal fit.
Glaux operation focus translated title/window outside frame: Glaux excluded from this adjustment.
Automation zoom override was in an unreachable graph branch: moved to rawCamera; final form through Save is visible.
limitations: This is a scripted, source-grounded cinematic app reconstruction, not live ATHENA backend execution.
Homepage motion grammar and dimensions are reused; Glaux retains the film companion composition rather than reproducing the entire website spreadsheet-desktop minimization scene.
A 60-second film cannot explain all 23 capabilities at equal depth; secondary features are brief visible operations.
Visual coverage is sampled states plus independent boundary/geometry checks, not visual inspection of every final encoded frame.
Adjacent off-focus panels may be cropped during deliberate zooms; primary action/result was checked at its reveal or result point.
